result.stdout:
hyperplane-server — local vector decision model server

Usage:
  hyperplane-server [serve] [options]   Serve the Decisions API and Venn-compatible routes
  hyperplane-server quickstart          Run an outcome-store example on authored vectors
  hyperplane-server download-head       Download and verify the venn-1 head
  hyperplane-server --self-test         Start on a free port, exercise every route, exit

Options:
  --host <addr>          Listen address (default 127.0.0.1)
  --port <n>             Port (default 8000; 0 picks a free port)
  --request-timeout-ms <n> Per-request deadline in milliseconds (default 0: disabled)
  --allowed-host <name>  Accept this Host header (repeatable; default loopback names)
  --home <dir>           Persist families and calibrations under <dir>/registry
  --head-dir <dir>       Load the venn-1 head from <dir> (default HYPERPLANE_HEAD_DIR,
                         then the download cache when present)
  --download-head        Download the venn-1 head to the cache before serving
  --heuristic            Use the uncalibrated cosine head instead of venn-1
  --reader <kind>        none (vectors only, venn-1 profile) or deterministic
                         (hash vectors under an experimental profile, for demos)
  --dimensions <n>       Deterministic reader dimensions (default 64)
  -h, --help             Show this help
